- **[When scoped Git change control is enough](products/evidence-registry/study-scoped-git.html).** Both workflows accepted 2 authorized repairs in 4 matched paths. Both restored the remote file state. Scoped Git retained the original effect in ordinary branch ancestry and created 0 additional receipt files. The governed arm retained it on an audit ref and created 14 additional receipt files.
- **[When a second receiver check changes closure](products/evidence-registry/study-crossed-receiver.html).** Conventional status closed 128 of 160 matched cases. The added read closed 144. All 16 extra closures occurred with stale or unavailable conventional status, a fresh second read, and no receiver deduplication. Both workflows closed 32 cases each when both observations were fresh.
- **[Which scope earns a verifier rollout?](products/evidence-registry/study-verifier-rollout.html).** Public-copy correctness rose from 9 to 11 of 12. Protected record-change correctness fell from 12 to 8 of 12. Both workflows matched the authored decision at all 28 checkpoints. Document inspections went from 140 to 80, with 16 added writes.
